Tap to turn on Dictator under Accessibility
Tap to toggle · hold to talk
Tap to show it in text fields
Dictator listens only while you dictate, and transcribes on this phone. Audio is never saved.
Turn on Dictator under Accessibility. It types into the field you are in, and reads only that field so the words land at the cursor. Nothing is stored.

Installed the APK yourself and Android says "App was denied access" or "Restricted setting"? Open Settings → Apps → Dictator, tap ⋮ (top right), choose "Allow restricted settings", then turn on Dictator under Accessibility again.
The microphone is the only button you need. If Android also shows its own accessibility shortcut button, you can turn it off under Settings → Accessibility → Dictator → Dictator shortcut.
One microphone. It appears when a text field is focused. Tap to start and stop, hold to talk, drag to move it.

Dictator is not a keyboard, so it never replaces the one you type with. Audio stays on this phone. The button reads the focused text field, in memory, only to place the dictation. It never uses the clipboard.

Types dictated speech into the text field you are using. Dictator reads that field so the words land at the cursor, with the right spacing. It does not read the rest of the screen, and it stores nothing.
Tap here, then tap the floating mic…
Audio never leaves the device; the one-time model download is the only network use. MIT licensed.
Allow the microphone in Dictator to dictate.
Listening. Tap or release to finish
The microphone appears in a text field
The text field went away before the text could be typed.
Turn on Dictator under Accessibility so it can type into the field.
This field can\'t be typed into.
%1$s is downloaded and ready. Dictation works offline.
Dictator needs the %1$s speech model (%2$s MB), downloaded once. Wi-Fi is recommended.
Waiting for Wi-Fi (or a connection) to download the model…
Downloading the speech model you choose, from Hugging Face, is the only network use. Every file is checked against a SHA-256 hash built into the app. Your audio never leaves the device.
Most accurate for English (6.1% average word error rate on the Open ASR Leaderboard).
Less accurate than Parakeet; smaller download.
Fast on the phone\'s CPU, without Whisper\'s 30-second windows.
Slower on long dictations; smaller download.
Dictator transcribes on this phone. Choose one model; only that one is downloaded, and only after you confirm. You can switch later.
Cancel the running download to switch models.
Choose a speech model above. Nothing is downloaded until you choose one and tap Download.
